x_t_leakage_note: At small t, x_t = (1-t)x0 + t x1 leaks x0 into the model input, which weakens the no-text MSE floor. All probes use t=0.999 (x_t ~= x1 pure noise) so the gap is a valid floor. Training itself samples t uniformly in [0,1].

data_gap.definition: mean_k || image_to_tokens(y_k) - mean_k(...) ||^2 = Var_k(y_k) in token space

text_features.encoder_note: toy HashTextEncoder reads the FIRST 8 tokens; if all prompts shared a preamble this would be 0

verdict: NOT-YET-SUPPORTED: wrong text still barely changes the loss; train longer / bias training t toward 1 / check that the checkpoint was trained on THIS multi-target dataset
